system_prompt: You are a careful causal discovery expert. Your task is to convert variable semantics into a plausible causal order prior. Do not claim that the order is ground truth. Return strict JSON only.
rationale: Early variables are underlying risk factors and congenital conditions; disease and cardiac/pulmonary physiology drive oxygenation, flow, and symptoms. Imaging and report variables are downstream measurements of clinical state, so they come later. Exact biological ordering among physiology nodes is uncertain, so this is a semantic prior rather than a claim of ground truth.
